import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for Age
data['Age'] = 2023 - data['Year_Birth']

# Set the size of the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a boxplot for Income by Marital Status
sns.boxplot(x='Marital_Status', y='Income', data=data, palette='Set2')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Income Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Income', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
